description:
Goal
Preserve exact direct-only callable transport across executable boundaries without widening it back to ValueRef or first-class callable materialization.

Problem being fixed
Compiler2 already had enough information to keep direct-only callable transport exact, but one seam in callable witness settlement lost origin context. When an executable input is satisfied from a closure-capture prefix, the captured ValueId belongs to the exact callable producer's origin executable, not the incoming caller executable. The old witness walk read those captured ValueIds in the caller context, so exact direct-callable evidence collapsed to NonDirect and downstream transport fell back to ValueRef.

Concrete repro
- compiler2_native_program_keeps_direct_only_enum_reduce_out_of_callable_inventory
- compiler2_native_program_jit_runs_enum_reduce_through_compiler2_codegen
- compiler2_abi_ready_passes_direct_callable_captures_without_a_heap_closure_lane

In the failing Enum.reduce path, the bridge executable already received a reducer as DirectCallable { function: 164, captures: [DirectCallable { function: 65, captures: [] }] }. The later executable for function 164 still settled input 0 to ValueRef because the witness solver followed the capture through the caller executable instead of the producer executable.

Root cause
CallableWitnessState::Exact(LocalCallableId) is executable-local. The state itself was fine; the bug was the traversal. compute_input_witness handled capture-prefix inputs by resolving the closure callee to an exact local callable, then reading callable.captures[capture_index] and asking value_witness(caller_exec, capture). That caller exec was wrong. The capture's ValueId must be interpreted in callable.exec.

Design decision
Do not introduce a new recursive semantic witness model. Keep exact witness state small and origin-aware. Derive recursive RuntimeValueLayout only after witness settlement. Push representation decisions down into the existing transport layout, not up into semantic witness facts.

Required changes
1. In src/compiler2/jobs/artifact.rs, make capture-prefix witness propagation resolve captured values in the exact callable producer's origin executable.
2. Keep RuntimeValueLayout derivation downstream of settled witness state.
3. Remove temporary enum-reduce debug scaffolding used during tracing.
4. Finish the native return seam by treating internal returns as transport lanes shaped by return_layout, not by re-materializing a whole runtime value from env and then relying on boundary ABI metadata.
5. Split NativeBody's internal return-lane metadata from boundary-facing return_abi so codegen can stay lane-level and callable-agnostic.

Removal target
- Delete temporary debug tests/dumps used to inspect enum_reduce transport.
- Delete any native return path that re-materializes direct-only callable results into MakeFnRef/MakeClosure solely to satisfy internal return delivery.
- Delete local assumptions that ReturnAbi alone describes internal native return transport.

Checks
- cargo check --all-targets
- cargo test compiler2_abi_ready_passes_direct_callable_captures_without_a_heap_closure_lane --lib
- cargo test compiler2_native_program_keeps_direct_only_enum_reduce_out_of_callable_inventory --lib
- cargo test compiler2_native_program_jit_runs_enum_reduce_through_compiler2_codegen --lib
- cargo test compiler2_interp_runs_quicksort_from_backend_artifacts --lib
- cargo test compiler2_native_program_contract_maps_old_native_inputs_to_local_facts --lib

Outcome
Direct-only callable transport now remains exact through executable-boundary witness settlement and internal native return delivery without introducing first-class callable entries or pushing higher-concept callable decisions into codegen.
title: Compiler2 runtime transport: preserve exact direct-callable capture transport across executable boundaries
